episodes.synopsis: A writer of riddle books for children, Momosuke Yamaoka's ambition is to compile a book of 100 ghost stories.
episodes.title: The Red Bean Washer

episodes.synopsis: Momosuke arrives at Kichibe's Willow Inn, hoping to learn about the fabled Willow Woman who is said to haunt the inn.
episodes.title: Willow Woman

episodes.synopsis: Momosuke encounters a hunter named Yasaku while investigating the tale of Hakuzōsu, a legendary fox who posed as a monk to tempt a hunter away from killing foxes.
episodes.title: White Fox

episodes.synopsis: Momosuke arrives at a town where a woman named Oyoshi is being chased by a ronin named Matajuro Ishikawa.
episodes.title: Dancing Head

episodes.synopsis: The trio go to investigate a house on a hill where there have been reports of people dissapearing.
episodes.title: Salty Choji

episodes.synopsis: Momosuke and the Ongyou encounter a traveling performance troupe which includes a samurai who claims to be a Tanuki, a Raccoon Dog that assumes human form.
episodes.title: The Shibaemon Racoon Dog

episodes.synopsis: Momosuke hears the legend of the Katabira Crossroads where some women have mysteriously died.
episodes.title: Katabira Crossroads

episodes.synopsis: Momosuke responds to a supposed letter from his brother Gunhachiro sent to him while at Katabira Crossroads.
episodes.title: Field Gun

episodes.synopsis: Hearing about the murderous cutthroat Giamon of Inarizika, rumored to be a Kowai (a ghoul that can survive any fatality), Momosuke learns some of Ogin's past.
episodes.title: The Lone and Strange

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in town, Momosuke runs into a man and learns of the missing bride Shiragiku.
episodes.title: The Succubus

episodes.synopsis: Momosuke hasn't seen the Ongyou for months. When he asks Tsutaya if he's heard of any ghostly rumors lately, Tsutaya tells Momosuke that there are two he knows of, with one of them being the sea ghosts of Sanuki.
episodes.title: The Marine Spirits

episodes.synopsis: Strange massacres have been occurring at Seven Man Point.
episodes.title: The Death Spirits of Seven Man Point, Part 1

episodes.synopsis: After Ukon ends up captured by Danjo's servant Kaburagi, Momosuke infiltrates the dungeons in order to rescue him.
episodes.title: The Death Spirits of Seven Man Point, Part 2
